info.title: Pluto Server API
info.description: REST API backend for Android application supporting Google Sign-In, exchange rate synchronization, and cloud backups.

idToken.description: Raw Google ID Token (JWT) obtained from Google Sign-In SDK on the Android client

baseCurrency.description: User's preferred reporting currency (ISO 4217). Null lets the server default apply.

accessToken.description: Short-lived JWT access token for authenticating REST API requests

expiresIn.description: Access token expiration time in seconds (e.g. 900 for 15 minutes)

refreshToken.description: Refresh token for rotating session and obtaining new access tokens

email.description: Account to sign in as. Defaults to dev@pluto.local.

refreshToken.description: Cryptographically secure refresh token previously issued to the client

nextDueOn.description: Earliest pending occurrence, else the next scheduled date

categoryId.description: Identifier of an expense category owned by the caller

amount.description: Amount due each occurrence, in the rule currency

startDate.description: Anchor date the cadence counts from; a past date only anchors the schedule

endDate.description: Stop generating occurrences after this date

expenseId.description: The expense created when this occurrence was confirmed

ids.description: Specific occurrence ids to confirm. Omit to confirm every pending occurrence.

confirmed.description: How many pending occurrences were turned into expenses

recurringExpenseId.description: The recurring rule that generated this expense, if any

endDate.description: Stop generating occurrences after this date, or null to clear

status.description: Pause or resume the rule. `PAUSED` suppresses generation; `ACTIVE` resumes.

expenseCount.description: Number of expenses filed under this category

name.description: Unique category name within the account

policies.description: Distinct policies applied; includes unavailable when any line failed

total.description: Subtotal converted into the base currency

secondaryTotal.description: Subtotal in the secondary currency, when one was requested

secondaryTotal.description: Subtotal in the secondary currency, when one was requested

baseCurrency.description: Currency all converted figures are expressed in

converted.description: False when no rate snapshot was available; totals are then null and only byCurrency is populated

unconvertedCurrencies.description: Native currencies within the range that could not be converted

total.description: Period total in the base currency

average.description: Period average per expense in the base currency
